newsitem.title: BRAZIL: RESEARCH ALERT-Multicanal still a buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Multicanal still a buy.

text.p: Lazard Freres & Co Llc said it maintained its buy rating but lowered its price target and was revising downward its earnings estimates on Brazilian cable TV holding Multicanal Participacoes .

-- "Multicanal reported disappointing second-quarter results as subscriber growth suffered from a Brazil-wide consumption slowdown compounded by a spike in delinquencies," said Lazard Freres analyst Alfredo Jollon in a report.

-- He cut his 12-month price target for the stock to $15 per American Depositary Receipt (ADR) from $18 per ADR and was revising downward earnings estimates to reflect the first half's weakness, he said.
-- Though the share has fallen 13 percent this year, "we believe further downside risk is limited," he wrote.
-- He added investors appear to have discounted the first half and now look forward to a positive impact from second-half subscriber growth and upcoming license auctions on valuations.
-- The share remains attractive at its present valuation of $1,195 per 1998 equity subscriber and 9.7 times 1998 EBITDA estimate, Jollon said.
-- Multicanal Participacoes' preferred rose 3.6 percent to 1.15 reais in Sao Paulo while its ADR moved up 1/4 to 11-1/8 in New York at 1644 local/1944 GMT.
